newsitem.title: USA: Exsorbet says receives $3.3 mln investment.
newsitem.headline: Exsorbet says receives $3.3 mln investment.

text.p: Exsorbet Industries Inc said Friday that American Physicians Service Group Inc has invested $3.3 million to purchase 1.2 million shares of Exsorbet common stock.
Exsorbet completed its acquisition of 7-7 Inc on September 30, using funds primarily obtained from the investment.

The purchase is subject to a 60-day due diligence period during which American Physicians can elect to have Exsorbet repurchase all or a portion of the stock for cash or a promissory note due October 1, 1997.
